note: No Instagram account connected. Trends are what is currently popular in these three domains, not a platform-wide census.
source: public Instagram trend discovery (social.search, platform=instagram, ranked by engagement)

trends.title: Haul season peaks — H&M red bows, Zara sequins, and cozy loungewear
trends.details: A 59K-like carousel posted today presents a Guess accessories editorial — an all-white tailored suit with a brown leather hobo bag and a two-tone wristwatch, then a black lace maxi dress with sheer leg panels layered under a leopard-print faux-fur coat with a matching mini bag. A 30K-like reel models an H&M party haul — a bright red one-shoulder mini dress with a large bow, a black off-the-shoulder mini, a red high-neck mini with black knee-high boots, a floor-length gold sequin slip dress, a long dark purple satin gown, and a white turtleneck with a brown sequin pencil skirt. A 24K-like Zara try-on haul runs six looks — an oversized grey knit sweater tucked into a silver sequin midi skirt, a white satin wrap blazer mini-dress, a burgundy tweed cropped cardigan with feathered cuffs, a black sequined camisole with a choker tie, a black long-sleeve mini dress with an asymmetrical drape, and a black-and-white plaid cropped jacket with a faux-fur collar. A 25K-like Snidel Home lookbook leans cozy — loungewear and pajamas with teddy bear graphics, a giant red velvet bow over white pajamas, red heart-print pajamas with fairy lights, and a navy sweater with earmuffs. A 14K-like get-ready reel builds a full glam look around a floor-length champagne sequined halter gown — clear heels, dangling crystal earrings, red lipstick, a small silver sequined clutch, and a long white faux-fur coat. A 10K-like reel builds five party outfits around one burgundy lace strapless bustier top — dark purple wide-leg trousers, a black blazer, a black satin asymmetrical midi skirt, black sequin mini shorts, and white wide-leg trousers.

trends.title: Deck every room, not just the tree — castle Christmas, ribbon weaving, and plaid kitchens
trends.details: A 26K-like vlog decorates for Christmas 'besides the tree' — ceramic gingerbread houses and a large Santa statue, a fresh wreath and an 'OH WHAT FUN' banner, mantel garland with dried orange slices, monogrammed gingham stockings, garland draped across the kitchen cabinets, and a gingerbread village display on the counter. A 26K-like tour shows Highclere Castle at Christmas — a gravel drive lined with potted evergreen trees, a candlelit dining room with a lit tree, a staircase dressed with illuminated garlands and bows, and drawing rooms filled with elaborately decorated trees. A 20K-like reel posted today decorates a tree in red — warm white fairy lights, white snowflake ornaments, crystal bead garlands, and a large white satin bow topper, with a nutcracker and reindeer figurine on the media console. A 12K-like reel reveals 'the cutest tree you ever will see' — a flocked tree with plush ornaments (a smiling cloud, a 'Milk For Santa' bottle, a gingerbread man), red glass baubles, pinecones and warm white lights, sitting in a white wicker basket. A 10K-like reel decorates a bright kitchen — a red plaid vinyl cover on the fridge, Santa, tree and cardinal ceramic plates on a green wall, greenery garlands with fairy lights and dried orange slices above the sink, and big red ribbons on the cabinet doors so they look like wrapped gifts. A 9K-like tutorial teaches ribbon weaving — a wide metallic gold sheer ribbon looped in a zig-zag into the branches every few inches, with the reassurance that imperfections will not show once the tree is finished.

trends.title: Glitter lips win Christmas — before-and-after glam, hooded-eye holidays, and MAC Fizzy Feels
trends.details: A 62K-like before-and-after reel goes from a messy bun and satin robe to long styled hair, full makeup with blush and lipstick, and a red top. A 50K-like reveal starts in minimal makeup and a pink robe, then lands on heavy eye makeup, blush and shiny glitter lipstick, captioned 'GLITTER LIPSTCK IS THE BEST FOR XMAS MAKEUP :)!'. An 18K-like tutorial posted today demos 'holiday makeup for hooded eyes' — red-pink shadow blended above the crease with a cotton pad as a shield for a lifted winged effect, a shimmery pink lid, and mascara. A 13K-like clip presents Thanksgiving dinner glam — short curly platinum-blonde hair, sharp dark brows, pink-purple eyeshadow, heavy contour and highlight, and glossy lips with a black turtleneck. An 11K-like 'sexy winter wonderland' tutorial skips bronzer for a cool-tone contour, layers baby-pink cream blush under a muted pink powder blush, and finishes with a nude lip and a white faux-fur coat. A 7.2K-like review tries MAC's holiday 'Fizzy Feels' lipsticks — 'Fizzy Bubbles', a light pink glitter, and 'Crystal Caviar', a darker brownish-purple glitter — silky with no gritty feel, swatched and worn with matching lip liners.
